تحتفلين (form VIII)
# تَحْتَفِلِينَ (taḥtafilīna) /taħ.ta.fi.liː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِحْتَفَلَ (iḥtafala)
# تُحْتَفَلِينَ (tuḥtafalīna) /tuħ.ta.fa.liː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَفَلَ (iḥtafala)
